definitions.explanation: Preparatory work done before the main task, especially in cooking (washing, cutting, marinating ingredients) but also used more broadly for any advance preparation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{下準備|したじゅんび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Do the prep work for the vegetables.
I finished the cooking prep the day before.

examples.japanese: ⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧な{下準備|したじゅんび}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欠|か}かせない→欠かす：10138_kakasu⟧。
examples.english: Thorough preparation is indispensable for the success of an event.

notes:
{下準備|したじゅんび} literally means "under-preparation" — the groundwork done before the main task.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {下準備|したじゅんび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (do prep work)
- {下準備|したじゅんび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{済|す}ませる→済む：01950_sumu⟧ (finish the preparation)
- {下準備|したじゅんび}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧ (preparation is important)
- {下準備|したじゅんび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{時間|じかん}がかかる→時間がかかる：26082_jikangakakaru⟧ (preparation takes time)

Most commonly used in cooking contexts, where it refers to tasks like washing, peeling, cutting, and marinating ingredients before the actual cooking begins.
